headline_seed: US regulator to review Disney broadcast licences after Jimmy Kimmel joke about Melania Trump
description_seed: The move comes as the White House pressures Disney-owned ABC to fire Kimmel after he called Melania an "expectant widow".

what: US regulator to review Disney broadcast licences after Jimmy Kimmel joke about Melania Trump

clean_source_blocks.text: The US media regulator has ordered an early review of Disney’s broadcast TV licences amid White House criticism of late-night host Jimmy Kimmel’s joke about Melania Trump.
The move comes as the White House pressures Disney-owned ABC to fire Kimmel after he called Melania an "expectant widow".
The US Federal Communications Commission is ordering an early review of Disney's television broadcast licences days after President Donald Trump called for the firing of late-night host Jimmy Kimmel.

The review comes after Kimmel did a send-up of the annual White House Correspondents’ Association dinner on his ABC show last Thursday, joking that US first lady Melania Trump had “a glow like an expectant widow.”
